answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study to understand how humans perceive explanations provided by different scalarizers and attribution methods, and whether they can discern performance differences akin to the quantitative evaluations in Section 4.
answer_4.guideline: We designed an online survey consisting of three parts. Each part showed an input text, randomly drawn from the ten examples, and its summary, generated by the DistilBART model.
